# Backend Column Name Fix - Applied ✅

## 🚨 Error Fixed

**Error:** `Unknown column 'created_on' in 'field list'`

**Root Cause:** The INSERT statement was using `created_on`, but the table has `created_at` (which is auto-generated).

---

## ✅ Fix Applied

**File:** `D:\Development Project\Printechs WMS\wms-api\src\modules\cartons\cartonController.js`

### Changes Made:

**Before (WRONG):**
```javascript
INSERT INTO tabReceivingCarton 
(carton_id, advance_shipping_notice, inbound_session, status, created_on, updated_on, received_by, updated_at)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())
```

**After (CORRECT):**
```javascript
INSERT INTO tabReceivingCarton 
(carton_id, advance_shipping_notice, inbound_session, status, updated_on, received_by, updated_at)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())
```

**Removed:** `created_on` (doesn't exist - table has `created_at` which is auto-generated)

---

## 📋 Table Schema Reference

**tabReceivingCarton columns:**
- ✅ `created_at` - Auto-generated (DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - **Don't set manually**
- ✅ `updated_at` - Auto-updated (ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - **Can use NOW()**
- ✅ `updated_on` - Manual timestamp - **Set manually**

---

## ✅ Fixed Locations

1. ✅ Single carton INSERT (line ~354)
2. ✅ Batch carton INSERT (line ~422)

---

## 🎯 Result

After fix:
- ✅ INSERT will work correctly
- ✅ `created_at` will be auto-generated by database
- ✅ `updated_on` will be set to current time
- ✅ `updated_at` will be auto-updated
